legal.description: Bloomberg reported Builder.ai and VerSe Innovation allegedly engaged in 'round-tripping' between 2021-2024, billing each other ~equal amounts without actual services. Builder.ai collected ~$60M from VerSe; VerSe paid ~$80M to Builder.ai. VerSe denied all allegations as 'factually incorrect, absolute
legal.notes: No formal ED/RBI action confirmed as of 2026-09-15; VerSe states all transactions verified by Big Four auditors

legal.description: Deloitte flagged lack of 'appropriate internal controls' over IT, advertising revenue, and supplier relationships in VerSe's FY24 financials, stating weaknesses 'could potentially result in material misstatement'. However, Deloitte maintained a 'true and fair' opinion on the financial statements.
legal.notes: Auditor opinion; not a regulatory penalty

legal.description: Builder.ai filed for bankruptcy after Viola Credit seized $37M; US prosecutors issued subpoena for financial records. Builder.ai alleged VerSe participated in revenue inflation scheme.
legal.notes: US bankruptcy proceedings; VerSe not named as defendant in any confirmed ruling
